WoW: Forever

Holy Priest

The reactive Light healer. Icy Veins' line on it is beginner-friendliness: "great all-rounders… very beginner-friendly." Both guide sites say not to level purely as Holy unless you are in groups, and both publish a build for doing it anyway.

WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60, checked against client 1.60.1.70938 on November 13, 2026. Talent rows open at 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40, one point a level from 10, 51 points at 60. The one-point talents are gated on points spent in the tree, not on level. Talent rows, ranks and numbers are read from the client. Blizzard's September 30 Class Deep Dive, its November 2 notes and its launch hotfixes outrank the client and the guide sites. Every talent build below is a published one, named and dated. Binding Heal is not in the game: Blizzard removed it on November 2, and Wowhead's and Icy Veins' Holy pages still list it. No raid opens before December 9, 2026, so the level-60 builds rest on their authors' judgement and on no raid log. Where a tooltip differs from the text, go by the text: tooltips can lag a hotfix.

What Holy is for

Raw healing throughput and group healing. Icy Veins' ratings: Overall 4.0, Levelling 2.0, Dungeon 5.0, Utility 4.0, Mobility 1.0. The levelling number measures solo kill speed and nothing else. Its heading is "Pitiful AoE and Lackluster Damage": "While Holy Priests are great at their role of healing, they lack tools to solo level effectively. It's typically recommended to play with a group if you plan to level as Holy, otherwise it is a better idea to primarily use Shadow talents until you're able to get into group content."

Wowhead says the same. Its levelling page (November 9): levelling purely as Holy is not the recommended path, Discipline levels faster while still covering dungeons, Shadow is faster still alone, and Holy is workable with friends or in dungeons.

If you are levelling in groups, Icy Veins rates Holy 5.0 out of 5 for dungeons, level with Discipline. Its own comparison: Holy thrives when the whole group is taking damage, and Discipline is ahead on single-target healing and overall throughput.

A respec is a trainer visit. Icy Veins puts the first at 1 gold, rising each time. Dual Specialization is bought from the class trainer at level 40 for 50 gold (Wowhead's report; Blizzard gives the level and no price).

Stat priority

Icy Veins' order: Healing Power, MP5, Spirit, Intellect, critical strike.

Wowhead's order: Healing Power, Intellect, MP5, Spirit, critical strike. Wowhead labels its list speculative and wrote it before launch.

They differ on Intellect. Both give the same numbers: 15 Mana a point, and about 59 Intellect for 1% spell crit. Spirit regenerates Spirit divided by 4, plus 12.5, Mana every 2 seconds when you have not cast for 5 seconds. MeditationMeditationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. keeps half of that running while you cast, and Spiritual GuidanceSpiritual GuidanceTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit. turns Spirit into healing.

Critical strike is low on both lists. Icy Veins: "Critical Strike is likely the lowest of our stat priorities as a Holy Priest… crits you may get will often translate into accidental overhealing." Both sites add that it is not a dead stat, because InspirationInspirationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantYour non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec. triggers off non-periodic critical heals.

Hit does nothing for a healer. Healing spells do not miss, as Wowhead's stat page says. If you Smite, Holy PrecisionHoly PrecisionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%. in Discipline row 2 gives 6% Holy spell hit a rank.

The one-third figure belongs to a talent, not to gear. Spiritual GuidanceSpiritual GuidanceTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit. is what gives a bonus to spell damage "approximately one third as much as the bonus to spell healing". Nothing in Blizzard's post makes healing bonus on gear grant spell damage.
